title: Senior QA Engineer / SDET Lead
description: Senior QA Automation Architect and Quality Engineering Lead responsible for enterprise test strategy architecture (Test Pyramid), building custom TypeScript/Java test frameworks, implementing visual regression testing, parallel test sharding, Consumer-Driven Contract Testing (Pact), distributed load generation in Kubernetes, performance Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and executive QA KPI telemetry dashboards.

skills.rationale: Architecting enterprise test strategies, balancing the test pyramid, building executive KPI dashboards (DRE, MTTR), and creating production error feedback loops.
Building extensible test frameworks from scratch, implementing visual regression testing, and optimizing parallel test execution via CI sharding.
Establishing Consumer-Driven Contract Testing with Pact, service virtualization with WireMock, and utilizing database state validation as a test oracle.
Orchestrating distributed load testing in Kubernetes, conducting deep performance Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and leading screen reader accessibility audits.
Designing risk-based testing matrices, driving Shift-Left/Shift-Right quality governance, and managing session-based exploratory testing.
Leading business stakeholder UAT sign-offs, auditing multi-locale internationalization (L10n/i18n), and conducting usability heuristic audits.
Auditing Core Web Vitals in CI pipelines and inspecting complex real-time WebSocket/SSE streaming events.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in test strategy architecture, distributed automation, or quality governance.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Solid mid-level automation skills, but lacks experience in contract testing, distributed load orchestration, and enterprise test strategy.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong automation architecture capabilities; refining expertise in visual regression, Pact contract workflows, and performance RCA.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all senior expectations: designs scalable test frameworks, establishes quality engineering standards, governs CI/CD test sharding, and mentors teams.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds senior expectations: Principal/Staff SDET impact across multi-team engineering organizations, continuous quality innovation, and advanced resilience testing.
